#@ requires 1 == 1
    #@ ensures 1 == 1
    #@ assigns \nothing
    def collect_user_exceptions(stmts: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Set[str]:
        result = set()
        n = len(stmts)
        i = 0
        #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n
        #@ loop variant n - i
        while i < n:
            stmt = stmts[i]
            if stmt.get("stmt") == "Raise" and stmt.get("exc_type"):
                result.add(stmt["exc_type"])
            if stmt.get("stmt") == "Try":
                handlers = stmt.get("handlers", [])
                nh = len(handlers)
                j = 0
                #@ loop invariant 0 <= j and j <= nh
                #@ loop variant nh - j
                while j < nh:
                    h = handlers[j]
                    exc = h.get("exc_type")
                    if exc:
                        parts = exc.split("|")
                        np = len(parts)
                        k = 0
                        #@ loop invariant 0 <= k and k <= np
                        #@ loop variant np - k
                        while k < np:
                            ep = parts[k].strip()
                            if ep:
                                result.add(ep)
                            k += 1
                    result |= IRScanner.collect_user_exceptions(h.get("body", []))
                    j += 1
            if "body" in stmt:
                result |= IRScanner.collect_user_exceptions(stmt["body"])
            if "orelse" in stmt:
                result |= IRScanner.collect_user_exceptions(stmt["orelse"])
            i += 1
        return result
